name: ArkLib-Style Audit: Top-Level Theorem Review
description: ArkLib-style audit demo: Z3 rejects an inconsistent top-level theorem for a complex implementation, then verifies the reviewed theorem and optional Lean proof stamp.

intro: Step 1: LLM generates a complex implementation with a top-level theorem...
Step 2: mumei checks the reviewed requires/ensures contract...
narrative.before: review_top_level_theorem simultaneously requires equal and non-equal commitments.
narrative.after: The corrected theorem explicitly commits to the reviewed pre/post/invariant hash and returns the matching implementation commitment.

rejected.headline: BUG DETECTED! Top-level theorem is inconsistent
follow_up: Audit-facing contracts must be coherent before Lean proof stamps are trusted.
Buggy implementation requires implementation_commitment == input_commitment and != input_commitment.
Step 3: Verifying the reviewed top-level theorem...

pass.headline: Z3 verified reviewed audit theorem
follow_up: expected_commitment binds precondition, postcondition, and invariant hashes.
The implementation commitment matches the reviewed top-level theorem.
Step 4: Optional Lean proof stamp certifies the audit module...

steps.name: Z3 Bug Detection: inconsistent audit theorem
artifact_contract: detect_bug.log records the expected inconsistent theorem rejection.
steps.verifier_gate: Mumei/Z3 rejects the top-level audit theorem because its requires clauses contradict.

steps.name: Z3 Correct ArkLib Audit Verification
steps.verifier_gate: Mumei/Z3 accepts the reviewed top-level theorem and writes an audit proof certificate.

steps.name: Lean ArkLib Audit Proof Build
artifact_contract: lean_build.log records the optional ArkLib audit Lean module certification gate.
steps.verifier_gate: Lean certifies the ArkLib audit module when the optional proof file exists.

steps.name: Lean Bridge Certificate
steps.verifier_gate: The bridge converts the audit Z3 certificate into a Lean certificate dry run.

harness_contract.intent: Prove a reviewed top-level theorem is coherent before accepting ArkLib-style proof stamps.
artifact_contracts: Generate evidence: arklib_audit.proof.json, optional arklib_audit.lean-cert.json, harness_state.json, result.json, report.md, and per-step logs.
harness_state.json persists policy, compliance, intent fidelity, artifact inventory, and verification evidence for dashboard replay.
result.json records contradictory-theorem rejection, Z3 proof acceptance, optional Lean gates, artifact payload previews, and verification_evidence rows.
report.md explains top-level theorem review before/after evidence.
arklib_audit.proof.json is the L1 Z3 proof certificate for the reviewed theorem.
arklib_audit.lean-cert.json is the L3 bridge certificate when Lean assets are available.
dashboard/summary.md aggregates PASS and proof-density evidence for the scenario.
Gate order: l1_z3 -> l3_lean; each stage must satisfy its expected_exit, expected_patterns, artifacts, and depends_on contract before downstream evidence is trusted.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Audit-facing top-level theorem must have coherent pre/post/invariant commitments before Lean certification is trusted.
success_criteria: inconsistent theorem is rejected with Spec contradiction/requires_unsat.
Optional Lean build/bridge certifies ArkLib audit proof assets when available.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Low: contradiction and reviewed commitment are explicit in the L1 gates.
